About The Hub

A private front end for video, running on hardware you own.

Where your data lives

{{ icons.shield() }} Local first

Every social feature in this app writes to one SQLite file on this machine: hub.db. That includes:

  • Comments and replies, with their own likes and dislikes
  • Likes and dislikes on videos
  • Subscriptions
  • Playlists, Watch later, and Liked videos
  • Watch history, resume positions, and search history

None of it is sent to Google. Commenting here does not put a comment on YouTube; liking here does not like it on your account; subscribing here does not follow the channel on YouTube. That separation is deliberate — the point is a space that's yours, sitting alongside the real thing rather than writing into it.

What does leave this machine

Three things, and only three:

{{ icons.search() }}
Search queries
Sent to YouTube and Tubi when you search, the same as typing into their own search boxes.
{{ icons.film() }}
Stream requests
yt-dlp fetches the video itself from the source so it can play here.
{{ icons.upload() }}
Videos you publish from Studio
Only when you explicitly upload one, and only to the Google account you connected yourself.
